thesis: The podcast argues that AI models constitute a fourth pillar of infrastructure, distinct from traditional compute, networking, and storage, because they represent a fundamental shift where software abdicates logic to the machine rather than just abstracting resources. This new layer requires engineers to rethink how they build software and program systems, as models provide intelligence and often generate their own code, effectively disrupting the software development profession itself.
